title: Heat pump in Canada - Does it work long term?
summary: Southern Ontario homeowner reports two and a half winters on a ducted cold-climate heat pump with gas disconnected, low annual running costs offset by solar, and advises waiting until equipment fails.

assertions.quote: I've owned my heat pump in Canada uh for two and a half Winters now

verdicts.note: Heat pumps heat a large share of homes in Norway, Sweden and Finland and are spreading in Canada and Maine.

assertions.quote: we're using only the heat pump to heat our house at this point
cool your house in the summertime way better than your your current um central air conditioners

verdicts.note: A heat pump is the same refrigeration machine as an AC, and inverter models often have higher SEER2 ratings than typical installed ACs.
